title: Histopathological Examination of Iris Tissue in Buphthalmos
brief_summary: To revise the etiology of the primary congenital glaucoma in some infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* infants under age of 2 years
* 1ery glaucoma

Exclusion Criteria:

* infants more than 2 years
* 2ery glaucoma
* previous glaucoma surgery
